verdict.rationale: The evidence shows anti-blocking measures that relate to bot detection: rotating datacenter and residential IPs, a SessionPool that rotates proxies together with cookies, and support for Playwright and Puppeteer. Nothing in the pack documents an actual undetected or stealth browser mode, such as fingerprint spoofing or headless-detection evasion. Support for this story is therefore only adjacent and thin. Missing for 10: a documented undetected/stealth browser mode, browser fingerprint management, evidence of bypassing sophisticated bot-detection systems, independent or hands-on corroboration.
